blocks.text: In 2001, Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the platform category, Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
